budget_10_per10000.definition: An event alarms wrongly if any incorrect target exceeds its own frozen cutoff, even if the correct target also alarms. Count each event once, never19 times.
budget_10_per10000.uncertainty_scope: Binomial intervals assume independent events/groups; distinct groups do not prove physical independence.

zero_calibration_false_alarms.definition: An event alarms wrongly if any incorrect target exceeds its own frozen cutoff, even if the correct target also alarms. Count each event once, never19 times.
zero_calibration_false_alarms.uncertainty_scope: Binomial intervals assume independent events/groups; distinct groups do not prove physical independence.

macro.scope: Macro average across targets; shared negative events are not independent repeated trials.

budget_10_per10000.definition: An event alarms wrongly if any incorrect target exceeds its own frozen cutoff, even if the correct target also alarms. Count each event once, never19 times.
budget_10_per10000.uncertainty_scope: Binomial intervals assume independent events/groups; distinct groups do not prove physical independence.

zero_calibration_false_alarms.definition: An event alarms wrongly if any incorrect target exceeds its own frozen cutoff, even if the correct target also alarms. Count each event once, never19 times.
zero_calibration_false_alarms.uncertainty_scope: Binomial intervals assume independent events/groups; distinct groups do not prove physical independence.

macro.scope: Macro average across targets; shared negative events are not independent repeated trials.
